case: Two established answers each hold "which account" at the limit of the evidence, shown by a limitation that says the directory's log was not retained. Question 1's bound no other seat has reviewed: its review agrees the part is at the limit and is recorded best_candidate. Question 2's bound a seat that wrote neither it nor the answer reviewed as a negative is reviewed, before the answer's review: it stands established.
design: docs/adr/0013 'A part at the limit of the evidence': a limited part does not make an answer partial; claiming it costs what a negative costs: a seat that recorded neither the bound nor the answer reviews the bound with a negative's review, and until then an established attest of the answer is recorded best_candidate (limit_unreviewed), and the answers check warns.
docs/adr/0013 'The end of a run, under every stop policy': a best candidate is no disposition (B2); done finishes a run only when every question has one.
docs/adr/0015 'After the run s9722fa': an answer that claims established, every review of which holds it a best candidate, is held so, by readiness as by the done.
